idea-plugin.name: Implicit: Gaze-Triggered AI Assistance for Code Review
idea-plugin.description:
Gaze-triggered AI assistance for code review, inspired by the CodeGRITS research toolkit.

Simulates eye-tracking using mouse dwell time as a proxy for gaze.

Reading mode — mouse is moving; a circle marks the current line in the gutter.
Explaining mode — mouse rests 3 s; the line is highlighted and GPT-4o-mini explains it inline using the surrounding function as context.

Prototype for the Implicit project. AI-generated — may contain errors.
Requires OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable for AI explanations.
